heading: cyProof of rent arrears
paragraphs: cyAs your claim is on the grounds of rent arrears, you must now answer questions about:
bullets: cyhow much the rent is and how often it should be paid
cyhow much the arrears were on the date you served notice, if you served notice
cyhow much the rent arrears are today
afterBullets: cyYou must also provide proof of how the rent arrears have built up over time. You can either upload a rent statement or create one in this service.
cyThe defendants will be able to see your answers and any documents you upload.
